id: \bEach elevator leads to a different floor. Pick the right one to fight the gym leader.
en: \bEach elevator leads to a different floor. Pick the right one to fight the gym leader.

en: \bHeliolosk

en: \bI guess it's my job to defeat you.

en: \bYou might fight Clemont yet. If you pick the right floor.
it: \bPotresti ancora riuscire a sfidare Clemont. Se scegli il piano giusto.

id: \bThis leads to the top of Prism Tower.
en: \bThis leads to the top of Prism Tower.
it: \bDa qui si arriva in cima alla Torre Prisma.

en: \rBonnie: Hi \PN! Did you come to visit us?

id: \bLuxray
en: \bLuxray

id: \bTime to finish this.
en: \bTime to finish this.
it: \bÈ ora di farla finita.

id: \bThe right floor will take you to the top of the tower.
en: \bThe right floor will take you to the top of the tower.
it: \bIl piano giusto ti porterà in cima alla torre.

id: \bDedenne!
en: \bDedenne!
it: \bDedenne!

id: \bClemont uses Electric type Pokémon. They are weak against only the Ground type.
en: \bClemont uses Electric type Pokémon. They are weak against only the Ground type.
it: \bLem usa Pokémon di tipo Elettro. Sono deboli solo contro il tipo Terra.

id: \bThey are strong against Flying and Water. Flying, Electric, and Steel moves also don't do much damage.
en: \bThey are strong against Flying and Water. Flying, Electric, and Steel moves also don't do much damage.
it: \bSono forti contro Volante e Acqua. Anche le mosse Volante, Elettro e Acciaio non fanno loro molto danno.

id: \bLooks like you picked wrong.
en: \bLooks like you picked wrong.
it: \bSembra che tu abbia scelto male.

id: \bLooks like you won. This time.
en: \bLooks like you won. This time.
it: \bSembra che tu abbia vinto. Per questa volta.

id: \bClemont: It's finally time \PN. I've been waiting for this battle for a long time. I'm determined to give you a worthy fight. Let's begin.
en: \bClemont: It's finally time \PN. I've been waiting for this battle for a long time. I'm determined to give you a worthy fight. Let's begin.
it: \bClemont: Finalmente è il momento, \PN. Aspettavo questa lotta da tanto tempo. Sono determinato a darti una sfida degna di te. Cominciamo.

id: \bClemont: You've earned the Voltage Badge.
en: \bClemont: You've earned the Voltage Badge.
it: \bClemont: Hai ottenuto la Medaglia Voltaggio.

id: \bHere, have this TM too.
en: \bHere, have this TM too.
it: \bEcco, prendi anche questa MT.

id: \bTM115 contains Shock Wave. An electric attack that never misses.
en: \bTM115 contains Shock Wave. An electric attack that never misses.
it: \bLa MT115 contiene Ondashock. Un attacco elettrico che non manca mai il bersaglio.

id: \bClemont: That was an outstanding battle \PN. Bonnie and I are going to keep traveling for a while. I want to be able to stand on the same level as you.
en: \bClemont: That was an outstanding battle \PN.  Bonnie and I are going to keep traveling for a while. I want to be able to stand on the same level as you.
it: \bClemont: È stata una lotta straordinaria, \PN.  Io e Clem continueremo a viaggiare per un po'. Voglio riuscire a essere al tuo stesso livello.

id: \bClemont: It's good to see you again. I've been practicing everyday to grow as a Trainer and inventor.
en: \bClemont: It's good to see you again. I've been practicing everyday to grow as a Trainer and inventor.
it: \bClemont: Che piacere rivederti. Mi sono esercitato ogni giorno per crescere come Allenatore e come inventore.

id: \bClemont: \PN. I'm glad you had time to stop by before your match. I've been working on some battling techniques that should help you.
en: \bClemont: \PN. I'm glad you had time to stop by before your match. I've been working on some battling techniques that should help you.
it: \bClemont: \PN. Sono contento che tu abbia avuto il tempo di passare prima del tuo incontro. Ho lavorato su alcune tecniche di lotta che dovrebbero esserti utili.

id: \bAfter all, the future is now, thanks to science!
en: \bAfter all, the future is now, thanks to science!
it: \bDopotutto, il futuro è adesso, grazie alla scienza!

id: \bClemont: Well, the results weren't what I expected. But I should expect that coming from you.
en: \bClemont: Well, the results weren't what I expected.  But I should expect that coming from you.
it: \bClemont: Beh, i risultati non sono stati quelli che mi aspettavo.  Ma da te avrei dovuto aspettarmelo.

id: \rBonnie: You both did great! You're going to win your match for sure.
en: \rBonnie: You both did great! You're going to win your match for sure.
it: \rBonnie: Siete stati bravissimi tutti e due! Vincerai sicuramente il tuo incontro.

id: \bYou should hurry over. We'll be watching.
en: \bYou should hurry over. We'll be watching.
it: \bFaresti meglio a sbrigarti. Noi saremo lì a guardarti.

id: \bClemont: You should hurry over. We'll be watching.
en: \bClemont: You should hurry over. We'll be watching.
it: \bClemont: Faresti meglio a sbrigarti. Noi saremo lì a guardarti.

id: \bClemont: Wonderful timing, \PN. I was in need of someone to help me train.
en: \bClemont: Wonderful timing, \PN. I was in need of someone to help me train.
it: \bClemont: Tempismo perfetto, \PN. Avevo bisogno di qualcuno che mi aiutasse ad allenarmi.

id: \bClemont: That was a great battle. I look forward to our next one.
en: \bClemont: That was a great battle. I look forward to our next one.
it: \bClemont: È stata una gran bella lotta. Non vedo l'ora della prossima.
